responsibility: Implements CSKY ABI argument and return classification, deciding when aggregates are returned indirectly versus coerced into 32-bit register sequences and widening scalar integers to 32 bits.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/csky.rs`, this CSKY file classifies function arguments and returns for the calling convention, deciding indirect vs register-coerced aggregate passing and scalar widening, rather than defining inline-assembly registers and reserved-register diagnostics.
